丹麦卡伦堡为何被称为工业共生的活教材?这张企业之间的副产物交换网络是怎样织成的?

Why is Kalundborg in Denmark called the living textbook of industrial symbiosis, and how did its web of by-product exchanges between companies come together?

当地电厂、炼油厂、制药厂与石膏板厂历经数十年逐笔谈判,织成能流物流交织的网络:电厂余热为全镇供暖并向石膏板厂供应脱硫石膏,炼油厂处理后的中水回供电厂冷却,制药厂的生物污泥入田作肥。每个环节都由双边商业合同驱动,卖方变现废物、买方压低原料成本,全系统每年省下大量地下水与燃料并减少碳排。其精髓在于共生靠个案经济性自发涌现,而非出自行政规划。
Over decades of deal-by-deal bargaining, the local power station, refinery, pharmaceutical plant and gypsum board factory wove a network where energy and matter interlace: surplus heat warms the town and desulphurised gypsum feeds the board factory, treated process water returns to cool the power station, and biological sludge from drug fermentation fertilises farms. Each link rides on a bilateral commercial contract - sellers monetise residues, buyers cut input costs - sparing large volumes of groundwater and fuel every year. The essence is symbiosis emerging bottom-up from deal economics, never from administrative blueprint.

循环城市为何紧盯建筑拆除垃圾?「材料护照」与「建筑即材料库」提供了什么解法?

Why do circular cities zero in on construction and demolition waste, and what do material passports and buildings-as-material-banks offer as remedies?

因为建筑垃圾是城市固废中体量最大的一类,欧盟《废弃物框架指令》为此设定了2020年起建筑拆迁垃圾按重量70%回收利用的目标。循环解法分两层:存量层面推行材料护照,记录每栋建筑构件的材质与安装位置,让旧楼成为可供检索的材料仓库;增量层面改用螺栓连接等可逆构造与模块化构件,翻新或拆除时可整体卸下高值部件直接复用,而非一律破碎降级为路基回填料。
Construction and demolition debris makes up the largest single share of urban solid waste, which is why the EU Waste Framework Directive required seventy percent recovery of it by weight from 2020. The circular response works on two fronts. For the standing stock, material passports record each component's substance and position, turning older buildings into searchable warehouses of parts. For new builds, reversible bolted connections and modular elements allow high-value pieces to be unbolted intact during refurbishment or demolition for direct reuse instead of being crushed wholesale into roadbed fill.

什么是「城市代谢」?循环城市为何要把城市当作一个代谢系统来经营?

What is urban metabolism, and why should a city be run as a metabolic system?

指城市如生物体般持续吞纳食物、能源、建材与淡水,同时排出废水、垃圾与废气的物质能量流转过程。传统线性模式一头依赖原生资源开采、一头堆放废弃物,带来资源枯竭与污染的双重压力;循环城市据此借鉴自然养分流,把废弃物流重新设计为输入流——建筑垃圾再生骨料、餐厨垃圾厌氧产沼、灰水回收氮磷——以物质闭环让经济增长与原生资源消耗脱钩。
Urban metabolism describes how a city, like an organism, keeps drawing in food, energy, building materials and freshwater while discharging wastewater, refuse and exhaust gases. The conventional linear pattern leans on virgin resource extraction at one end and piles up waste at the other, producing twin pressures of depletion and pollution. Taking a leaf from natural nutrient cycling, circular cities redesign discard streams into inputs - rubble reborn as aggregate, kitchen waste digested into biogas, nitrogen and phosphorus recovered from greywater - so growth decouples from virgin extraction.
